messages:
ali_sales: Vanguard wants committed reserved capacity. Peak ~3k RPS chat. Mix ~60% short (~50t) / 40% long (~700t). They require AZ spread, 99.9% SLA on reserved capacity, and a legal fallback plan.

mike_se: Which models? That will drive GPUs/latency. Also confirm session KV usage (sticky sessions?).

sunita_ml: They'll run a 7B quantized primary and a 3B low-latency fallback. Rough perf: 7B ~1.15M tok/s/GPU. Avg tokens/request ~= 0.6*50 + 0.4*700 = 290 -> ~870k tok/s at 3k RPS. Ideal GPUs ~= 0.76. Ops buffer & cold KV -> recommend reserve 4 GPUs + 2 burst credits across AZs.

lee_ops: Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=1/az, target_util=65%, scale_up when util>80% for 30s, cooldown 5m. Preheat plan: 30-45m window, synthetic ramp and KV priming with customer top-500 prompts.

ali_sales: Legal: need graceful degradation order for contract.

sunita_ml: Degradation order: 1) route long responses to 3B in-region; 2) truncate long outputs / reduce max_tokens; 3) route non-critical traffic to hosted multi-tenant region; 4) return failure envelope with Retry-After header. Ensure session_compat tags so state migrates safely.

nora_security: Security paste-ready blurb for questionnaire: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). Data plane encrypted in transit and at rest. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM or S3 with configurable retention; network isolation via VPC peering and private subnets."

mike_se: I'll draft contract line + two pricing options (A: reserve 4 + 2 burst; B: reserve 6) and post numbers.

lee_ops: I'll add a short preheat/runbook checklist and route-policy draft to infra repo.

ali_sales: Action items: Mike -> pricing by EOD; Sunita/Lee -> confirm GPU count + attach perf doc; Nora -> paste KMS text into questionnaire. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
